links.outcome: Plus disease detection performance on external multicenter cohort versus single-center training
links.effect: AUROC 0.75 on external multicenter cohort of 8052 images; 84% sensitivity, 43% specificity, 96% NPV after operating point optimization
links.quote: ROP.AI was able to detect plus disease in an external, multicenter cohort despite being trained from a single center.

screen.reason: The study conducts a multicenter external clinical validation of a pre-existing single-center ROP deep learning tool (ROP.AI) across five tertiary centers and explicitly evaluates operating point optimization for real-world applicability.

primary.practice: multicenter external validation and operating point optimization
